Figures fetched from PMC at maximum available resolution and the effective-ppi ceiling computed BEFORE inspection: approximately 150 ppi for f1a/f2/f4/f5, 149 for f3, 143 for the portrait f1b. Dense panels were read by cropping and enlarging x3 rather than by re-rendering larger, which would have invented detail. All six images are fingerprinted in the manifest as figure artifacts.

Supplementary is unavailable, not unattempted: five routes were tried and the reason is structural — the paper is an NIH author manuscript outside the PMC open-access subset (oa.fcgi returns idIsNotOpenAccess; Europe PMC returns 'not open access one'; the bin route serves a JS interstitial). The cost is stated rather than glossed: Suppl. Figure 1 carries the P=0.0025 triglyceride datum the sex-specific story begins from, and no proposition recorded here rests on a supplementary value alone.

22 verbatim locators captured while the document was open. All 16 text and table snippets were verified against the declared artifact before being written, and none of them matches the abstract; the 6 figure locators are marked as attestations, because pixels cannot be quote-matched.

The result FT-039 asked for: the label 'strong evidence' does not transfer to the WWOX -> lipid -> myelin bridge, and the paper itself is the reason. Deleting Wwox in hepatocytes does NOT lower circulating HDL-C in either sex; only the whole-body null shows the HDL phenotype, measured in two-day-old pups of a line that dies by four weeks. The step actually licensed is WWOX -> ApoA-I/ABCA1 -> HDL biogenesis, whole-body and not hepatocyte-autonomous. The second leg, lipid homeostasis -> myelin, receives nothing: the paper measures no neural endpoint anywhere.

Three findings exist only in the panels, in none of the running text and in none of the captions. Figure 4F prints *P=0.0229 for males and P=0.0877 for females, so the ANGPTL4 increase is significant in males while the Discussion builds its female-specific triglyceride mechanism on ANGPTL4 in females. Figure 5E brackets Abca1 alone while the text claims both AbcA1 and ApoA-I mRNA fell — the CLAIM 005 distinction again. Figure 5 panels H and J arbitrate two P-values on which the text and the caption disagree, and they arbitrate one each way (0.0015 caption-correct, 0.0007 text-correct).

Figure 1A shows the risk haplotype is neither necessary nor sufficient: affected individual 401 carries no boxed haplotype, and founder 102 carries it as an unfilled symbol, i.e. above the 10th HDL-C percentile. The Discussion describes the co-segregation as perfect. Neither individual is named in the running text.

Figures: the Europe PMC open-access bundle serves them at 93-102 effective ppi; the article PDF embeds the same figures at 186-202. The embedded bytes were extracted rather than the page rendered, because rendering resamples. The significance brackets and axis values recorded below are not legible on the OA-package copy — the ppi ceiling has to be measured per retrieval route, not assumed from the route's authority.

The central quantitative finding is one only the panels carry. In the electron-microscopy figure the ONLY comparison drawn between wild type and rescued animals is the unmyelinated axon count, and it is significant AGAINST the rescue: about 26 per field in WT against about 52 in treated mice. In the panels where the rescue looks strongest the brackets run WT-vs-KO and KO-vs-rescued and never WT-vs-rescued, so the visible residual gap goes untested. The same pattern holds for CC1+ and PDGFRa+ counts. The g-ratio does normalise.

Therapeutic window: every efficacy number is conditioned on treatment at P0, and the authors state both the reason and the untested alternative. In WOREE the diagnosis follows seizure onset by months, so the inference from 'reverses the phenotype in mice' to 'would help a diagnosed child' crosses a gap the paper leaves explicitly open. Recorded with a REVIVAL_TRIGGER: a post-natal dosing experiment would change the reading of the whole paper.

Safety, as far as this paper goes: no gross tumour formation in a limited number of treated adults aged 8-11 months. The three qualifiers are the finding — gross, limited number, 8-11 months — in a tumour-suppressor null whose peripheral tissues remain null under a brain-restricted rescue.

Rule 5d positive control. The Methods sentence 'Results were considered significant when the P < 0.05' survives intact on this JATS surface. The identical sentence in the PDF of PMID 33914858 — same first author, same year, same laboratory — extracts as 'P 5 0.05' with the comparator destroyed, which is why FT-044 is suspended. Same sentence, two surfaces, one silently wrong: the policy is about the surface, not the paper.

Supplementary read in full but unequally citable. The Appendix (s001) passes the text-surface sentinel. The Review Process File (s002), 29 pages carrying three peer reviews and the authors' point-by-point response, is REFUSED by the sentinel for a U+0000 at offset 63867 and therefore carries no locator. Two reviewer objections are recorded as read-and-unquoted: that an n of 3 is the absolute minimum for these experiments, and that there is no evidence for absence in the PNS or for expression distal to the injection. Quoting either needs a page adjudication, a cost deliberately not paid today.

62 references enumerated, 36 gene-directed, and all 36 already known to LEGEND — the first reading in this corpus to add no unknown gene-directed reference. Three are notable: 24871327 read earlier today, 33914858 the suspended twin, and 30370248 the paper FT-047's own list had omitted.

Convergence with today's earlier reading, recorded as INFERENZA and not DATO: restoring WWOX only in neurons rescued peripheral phenotypes with no peripheral WWOX expression, while PMID 24871327 showed the liver-specific knockout failing to reproduce the whole-body HDL phenotype. For several WWOX phenotypes the tissue where the readout is measured is not the tissue where the gene must be present. Neither paper tests the other's organ.

The reading stopped where care could no longer be guaranteed, not where the material ran out, and the coverage map says so rather than rounding up.

No reading of this paper had ever taken place, so this event is the first contact with its text.
Read immediately after PMID 34747138 because it is its direct continuation: same laboratory, four years later, and the dose-response and timing study that the 2021 paper's single P0 dose left open.

IT FIRES THE REVIVAL_TRIGGER RECORDED EARLIER TODAY. The trigger written into the 34747138 record was that a post-natal dosing experiment would change the reading of that paper. It exists: high-dose AAV9-hSynI-hWWOX at any point from P0 to P5 fully rescues the null phenotype, with survival extended from about three weeks to nearly one year.

And the paper explicitly refuses to read its own ceiling as biology: intervention beyond P5 was not explored because the mice deteriorate, and the authors state that this reflects model-specific and technical constraints rather than a definitive boundary for therapeutic responsiveness, adding that human patients may allow later intervention. The correct entry is therefore: efficacy demonstrated P0-P5, upper bound unknown and unmeasurable in this model. Filing 'window = P0-P5' as a fact would manufacture exactly the silent, self-reinforcing false negative the epistemic discipline describes.

On oligodendrocytes it qualifies rather than closes yesterday's open question. An MBP-driven vector failed to confer benefit, but the authors attribute this to the limited oligodendrocyte tropism of AAV9 after neonatal ICV rather than to irrelevance of oligodendrocyte WWOX, and note all vectors were tested at one titer. A failed rescue by a vector with poor tropism for the target cell is not evidence that the cell does not matter. The genetic support for neuronal sufficiency comes instead from prior conditional knockouts: Nestin-Cre and Synapsin I-Cre recapitulate the phenotype, GFAP-Cre and Olig2-Cre do not.

Vector design recorded: WPRE was removed as a proactive risk-mitigation step rather than in response to observed toxicity, with efficacy recovered by dose optimisation. The authors declare that expression levels were not normalised across promoter conditions and that the electrophysiology cohort was limited.

THE DEBT IS LARGE AND NAMED. Every quantitative claim above is taken from the running text and NOT verified against its panel. Figure S8 carries the entire P0-P5 window result; Figure 7 the electrophysiology; Figure 6 the myelination quantification. Three consecutive readings have each carried a finding visible only in a panel, so this is the largest single risk in the current state and is recorded as such rather than left implicit.

One thread for the next session: this paper's Methods include sciatic nerve and spinal cord extraction, which is a candidate answer to the reviewer objection on PMID 34747138 — no evidence for absence in the PNS — that the refused review file made unquotable. Unread here.

Coverage is section-complete: abstract, introduction, five Results subsections, Discussion, ten Methods subsections, authorship/conflict/supplement statements and all 54 references were read sequentially. No keyword search was used as a reading method; technical search began only after vertical reading for registry deduplication and cross-query.

Figures were inspected as images, not captions. Main graphical abstract and Figures 1-4 were opened at original downloaded dimensions. The eight-page supplement was rendered page-by-page only after raster ceilings were measured and every page was inspected, including S1-S5 and Tables S1-S2.

Effective-PPI preflight preceded rendering. Main PDF figure rasters were approximately 299-300 PPI. Supplement pages 1-8 were measured as 175.9/225.3/276.4, 220, vector, 512, 45.2/84.5/125.5, 72, vector and vector; adaptive render DPI respected those ceilings. The nominal 500-dpi tag on scaled 761-pixel CDN JPGs was not mistaken for detail.

The primary scientific verdict is bounded: muscle-specific Wwox deletion is sufficient to generate local skeletal-muscle glucose-uptake and signalling defects plus systemic metabolic phenotypes, and acute C2C12 depletion supports a cell-intrinsic AMPK/ACC component. The whole phenotype is not proven tissue-autonomous because primary isolated fibre flux, muscle-specific rescue and AMPK causal rescue are absent and systemic insulin/glucose feedback remains possible.

This directly tests the operator's inference that measurement tissue can differ from necessity tissue: blood glucose, insulin, lipids, body composition and whole-body RQ arise after a muscle-targeted perturbation. Negative liver/adipocyte models in the tested states do not prove exclusive muscle necessity; the paper itself says other pathways and nutrient states remain unaddressed.

Visual audit qualifies negatives. Supplementary brain/liver FDG curves show no significance annotation rather than equivalence; the adipose blot is representative n=3, unquantified and only 45.2-125.5 effective PPI. Figure 2 I/J supports lower muscle FDG, and Figure 4 C/D supports the acute C2C12 phosphorylation change.

Quality limits include small heterogeneous n, multiple endpoints and time curves analysed only with stated Student t-tests, no reported multiplicity correction, randomisation, blinding or power calculation, male-only mixed-background animals, and an unresolved age discrepancy for ITT: Figure 2 caption says 10 months while Methods 4.4 says 6 months.

Retrieval and tooling friction was kept evidentially separate: NCBI OA tar returned 404, FTP denied directory access and PMC pages produced reCAPTCHA; Europe PMC supplied PDF and supplement. pdfinfo, pdfimages and identify were unavailable, so PyMuPDF/PIL geometry was used. The reusable figure_ppi_preflight.py plus regression test persists this fallback for other diseases.

No scientific current file was modified, no BATCH_COMMIT was attempted and the receipt ledger was not hand-edited. Canonical upgrade suggestions remain in a commit candidate for a future authorised batch.

evidence_basis: The complete PMC JATS body was read sequentially across all six sections, with the abstract separated from the evidentiary body and all 224 references enumerated rather than sampled.
The coverage map records that this narrative review has no methods section, no formal limitations section and no supplementary node, preventing absent surfaces from being silently treated as read.
Thirteen schema-v2 locators bind each carried proposition to the fingerprinted XML body, a table cell or one of two persistent figure artifacts in the shared checkout.
The cell-targeted model paragraph explicitly names Nestin, Synapsin, GFAP and Olig2 deletions and reports that only Nestin and Synapsin recapitulated null-like phenotypes in the stated interval.

The body distinguishes tissue of measurement from tissue of necessity by reporting neuron-targeted deletion with systemic phenotypes, neuron-to-oligodendrocyte non-cell-autonomy and neuron-targeted restoration with peripheral rescue.

The organoid metabolism signal is bounded as pathway enrichment in transcriptomic data, not a direct flux or bioenergetic measurement, and one severe human case is reported to have a normal metabolic screen.
Both figure JPEGs were restored to the persistent shared files tree with the same bytes and SHA-256 values previously captured; their native pixels were re-inspected after effective-PPI preflight.
Figure 1 is a qualitative expression schematic and Figure 2 a compressed model infographic; neither displays samples, uncertainty, a treatment window or quantitative comparative data.

The blind observation freeze and rule-based pattern assessment are persisted on the branch: negative GFAP/Olig2 arms disappear from the visual summary, but the comparison exists in the body, so the strong missing-designed-comparison pattern is scored absent.

A post-reading primary-source audit preserves the lithium tension: the review's KO-centred wording cannot establish Wwox-specific rescue when the inspected primary figure displays suppression in all three genotypes.
The dossier separates DATO about the review surface from cross-primary INFERENZA and keeps genotype, model, stage and therapeutic transfer explicitly low or conditional.
Strict schema-v2 validation was rerun from the shared checkout against persistent evidence rather than an ephemeral temporary worktree, verifying file existence, hashes and exact text snippets.

evidence_basis: A structured-surface search preceded PDF use and found complete PMC JATS XML for PMCID PMC13099603, changing the study from provisional pdf_only to structured full text.
The complete abstract, introduction, six result blocks, ten methods subsections, discussion, disclosures, data statement and all 77 references were read sequentially.
The coverage map explicitly records the absence of a main table and formal limitations section while preserving limitations reconstructed from the design and displayed evidence.
Eleven schema-v2 locators bind the conditional-genetic, carcinogenesis, EMT, p63 and human-tissue propositions to the fingerprinted XML or inspected figure pixels.

The genetic evidence distinguishes Wwox insufficiency alone from cooperation with p53 loss: no spontaneous tumour formation with Wwox loss alone, but increased penetrance and earlier onset with partial or complete p53 deficiency.
All six main figures and all ten supplementary pages were inspected as images after effective-PPI ceilings were measured; PyMuPDF was used only because Poppler was unavailable.

Pixel inspection caught that the Figure 2 caption describes EMT panels absent from Figure 2 and that the β-tubulin PLA control named in Figure 5A's caption is absent from the downloaded Figure 5 pixels.

The p63 mechanism is bounded by endogenous PLA, co-IP, abundance, rescue and target-occupancy evidence, while direct ITCH/proteasome stabilization remains attributed to prior work and ChIP-seq is visibly n = 1.
Four supplementary RNA-seq workbooks were inventoried by dimensions and sample groups, and the DMBA–TPA supplement was inspected as a p53-proficient sensitisation surface.
Human TMA concordance is kept observational because normal-versus-tumour grouping can drive the association and the paper supplies no adjusted outcome or prognostic model.
The rescue is identified as CMV overexpression, often above WT abundance, so reversal supports pathway dependence but does not establish a physiological dose or therapeutic window.

The review is classified as synthesis rather than new DATO: its experimental statements remain claims about cited primary papers and do not gain independent-replication status here.

The 2018 map establishes context dependence across strain, tissue, cell of origin and cooperating lesions, including mammary-development phenotypes without mammary tumours in several conditional models.
The review explicitly labels the residual-expression explanation for hypomorph survival as presumed and acknowledges unresolved inconsistencies among conditional-model phenotypes.
The body states that Mallaret et al. showed spontaneous and audiogenic seizures in a short-lived Wwox-KO mouse and assigns that claim to reference 53.

Reference 53 is a human autosomal-recessive cerebellar-ataxia paper, not a mouse experiment; reference 104 is the Wwox-mutant rat seizure study. The review therefore misattributes both source and species.
The summary repeats the mouse-seizure claim, whereas the completed primary PMID 19500159 chain explicitly separates mice without reported epilepsy from epileptic lde/lde rats.

Figure 1 was inspected as pixels only after the article-PDF page raster was measured at a 300-effective-PPI ceiling. It pools mouse and rat into one Rodents box and cannot support species-specific attribution.
The direct PMC and legacy Frontiers standalone-image routes returned HTTP 404, so the persisted PDF-embedded visual was used; it was never rendered above its measured raster ceiling.

No missing-needed-comparison pattern was sought or observed. The citation/species problem was noticed during sequential reading because it contradicted a known primary baseline, then confirmed by reading the numbered references.

Pancreatic-acinar Wwox loss alone produced no detected ADM or PanIN phenotype, so the experiment does not support autonomous sufficiency of tissue Wwox loss.
Wwox loss combined with KrasG12D accelerated precursor lesions and produced tumours in 16 of 64 KWC mice versus none of 14 KC mice.
Faster ductal transdifferentiation in isolated KWC acinar cultures supports a cell-autonomous component while the in-vivo immune and stromal findings preserve non-autonomous contributions.
Heterozygous and homozygous KWC cohorts were treated as identical throughout, preventing a clean Wwox dosage estimate and making inferred loss of heterozygosity retrospective.
Figure 2B's caption says n=3 in each group, but the main pixels and raw-blot supplement show two lanes for each of KWC, KC and WT; paired text/panel locators preserve the contradiction.
Figure 5 prints a binary 0/14 versus 16/64 comparison while the generic analysis states an unpaired t-test and names no binary-outcome or time-to-event test.
Figure 6's rescue expresses WWOX at 5.9 to 6.7 times WT and suppresses colonies below WT, establishing on-target direction but not physiological restoration.

evidence_basis: The complete PMC JATS body was read sequentially through all 60 body paragraphs, embedded captions, methods and 75 numbered references.
The coverage map includes four main figures, all four PPTX slides, both DOCX supplements and the single 47,731-row XLSB sheet.
Seven schema-v2 locators bind the mouse background, tumour latency, second-hit qualification, human deletion counts, survival-test boundary and rescue to fingerprinted surfaces.
The mammary Wwox line was backcrossed seven generations to tumour-susceptible C3H/HeJ, whereas the Trp53 comparator remained on B6/129; genotype and strain are therefore confounded.
Fourteen of seventeen Wwox-deleted mice developed mammary tumours with median latency 270 days, but the study itself says a C3H-facilitated second hit may be required.
Tumour profiling supports association of WWOX loss with Trp53-locus loss or repression, genome instability and impaired ATM/KAP1/p53 responses, without isolating the direct mechanism.
Figure 2 validates Trp53-locus copy loss in only two Wwox tumours by genomic qPCR after e-karyotyping suggested broad loss in three of four tumours.
Figure 4A's Fisher result rests on two double-deleted cases among five TP53-deleted tumours and six WWOX deletions among 2047 TP53-nondeleted tumours.
Figure 4B gives an omnibus four-group test but no pairwise double-versus-TP53-only comparison; the body does not claim an added WWOX survival penalty.

The caption's poorer-survival wording and the body's negative within-TP53 statement are interpretively inconsistent, but the pixels do not establish an opposite pairwise result, so no false text-panel contradiction was encoded.

evidence_basis: The complete local PMC HTML was read sequentially through every main paragraph and caption, and all 39 references were enumerated.
The complete 36-page supplement was read sequentially: methods pages 1–3, legends and inventory pages 4–8, figures pages 9–15 and tables pages 16–36.
Eight schema-v2 locators bind Wwox-alone negativity, cell-autonomous differentiation, early and mature lineage comparisons, cytogenetic prose and human IHC to fingerprinted surfaces.
Wwox loss alone impaired differentiation and mineralisation but produced no observed osteosarcoma in the single-knockout cohort.
Early Osx1-lineage Wwox/p53 double knockout reached complete penetrance and accelerated tumours relative to p53-only mice.
Mature Oc-lineage double knockout did not differ significantly from p53-only mice, so the WWOX-p53 tumour interaction depends on developmental cell stage.
Figure 3 explicitly draws both comparisons; this is not an instance of the needed comparison being absent.
The stage-specific result directly supports separating tissue of measurement from cell population and developmental stage of necessity.
Supplementary Table S6 totals 20 DKO but 30 p53-only spreads and separates break-bearing spreads from total breaks, conflicting with the body's twenty-metaphases-each and 6/20-versus-3/20 wording.
Human osteosarcoma IHC shows an association between p53-positive staining and low WWOX, but p53 genotype is inferred imperfectly from staining and causality is not established.
PPI was measured and persisted before rendering supplement pages 9–15; all six main and seven supplementary figures were inspected as images.

evidence_basis: Schema-v2 work manifest disease-models/wwox/research/deepdive_manifests/PMID38182577.json with 22 verified locators (7 body, 15 figure), six evidence_pair pairs of exactly two members each, zero gaps; strict PASS under deepdive_manifest.py --verify-artifacts --require-current-schema.

THE FINDING IS NOT BIOLOGY, IT IS A SURFACE. The published title states 'WWOX promotes osteosarcoma development via upregulation of Myc', which read literally asserts that WWOX promotes the tumour and raises MYC. Body, Figure 6 caption and abstract all state the opposite: WWOX LOSS raises Myc, WWOX add-back lowers it, and human OS with low WWOX carries higher MYC. The erratum PMID 38355659 corrects one author name and does not touch the title. The title is the artifact that propagates into PubMed, into the NOT_EVIDENCE abstract corpus and into title-level triage, so a model built from titles files WWOX as a bone oncogene. Landed as DL-METH-079.
No cross-tissue conflict exists: the direction matches PMID 29724996 read the same day in liver. WWOX suppresses MYC in both tissues.

Ten of the 22 locators are text_contradicted_by_panel, recorded in six pairs. Load-bearing: the WWOX 'restoration' of Fig 6G is a 9x overexpression driving Myc to 0.4, below the SKO baseline of 1; SKO Myc is not low but 2.6x control and significant; simvastatin does affect control marrow (viability 1.05 to 0.73 at 40 uM) against a text that says it does not; yBM penetrance is 42.9 percent printed and 'about 50%' written; the age-dependent reporter increase is significant at 2.5 months, not significant at 3.5 and 4, significant again from 5.

Simvastatin/MCM7 recorded as a repurposing seed with its limits attached, not as a candidate, in DL-THER-080: the drug lowers both MCM7 and c-Myc so the experiment does not separate the targets, the selectivity claim is contradicted by the paper's own Fig 7C, and no CNS rationale exists anywhere in the paper.

Figures obtained at original resolution 1835-1975 px from the Springer Nature CDN as PNG after the OA package FTP path returned 404 and the .jpg names declared by the XML returned seven byte-identical HTML error pages; the distinct-digest check caught that before any could be declared a figure. Europe PMC supplementaryFiles supplied both supplements. The retrieval cascade and its three traps are written into framework/manuals/deep_dive_manual.md section 10bis.

Bounded gap declared rather than concealed: supplementary panels S1-S5 are cited by the running text and were not individually adjudicated; MOESM1 was retrieved and fingerprinted but not read; MOESM2 (PowerPoint) was retrieved and not opened. Coverage records supplementary as not_read for that reason.

An earlier draft of this manifest declared an abstract-only sentence as body text; the abstract/body separation refused it and the locator was replaced with a Discussion sentence verified against the body surface.

DEPTH IS PARTIAL BY DECLARATION, NOT BY OMISSION. Body, all seven main figures and the reference list are read; the supplementary is retrieved, fingerprinted and NOT read. That gap is load-bearing rather than cosmetic: the claim 'Trp53 SKO yBM is not tumorigenic' rests on Fig S5A,B, which this reading has not adjudicated. The receipt writer refused complete_fulltext_read on exactly that ground and was right to; the manifest note claiming complete coverage has been corrected to match. Closing the gap means adjudicating MOESM1 panels S1-S5 and re-recording at complete depth with reread_reason inadequate_prior_coverage.

evidence_basis: Closes FT-046. All five supplementary figures S1-S5 inspected as full-page renders of MOESM1 at 220 dpi (1650x2384), recipe recorded in the manifest under supplement_page_renders: source PDF digest bf64e0e7133a, page, dpi and the digest of each image, so a reader with their own copy regenerates identical bytes without this repository redistributing the publisher's figures. THE SUPPLEMENT CORRECTED TWO OF MY OWN CONTRADICTION PAIRS, and both errors had the same shape: a text sentence matched against a main figure it does not cite. (1) 'about 50% of the mice developed OS tumors' cites Fig S5A,B, where the panel prints 11/21 = 52.4% and the sentence is ACCURATE; I had paired it with Fig 4D (12/28, 42.9%) and called it an upward rounding. (2) 'an age-dependent increase in the percentage of tomato-positive cells' cites Fig S4D, where the SKO series rises monotonically 9 to 21 to 58 percent; I had paired it with Fig 4A, whose ns marks answer a between-genotype question, not an over-time one. Both are now recorded as what they are, with the mis-attribution named in the proposition rather than quietly deleted.

WHAT THE SUPPLEMENT ADDS THAT NOTHING ELSE DOES. Two incompatible tumorigenicity counts for the same genotype sit unreconciled in one paper: DKO-yBM is 12/28 in Fig 4D and 11/21 in Fig S5B, different in numerator and denominator. MCM7 - the target the whole simvastatin arm rests on - is NOT higher in the panel the text cites for it: Fig S5F prints SKO 1 and 0.8 against DKO 1, 1.2 and 1.2, while the sentence claims a detected higher level of Myc AND MCM7. c-Myc protein in the same comparison takes a third value: 2.1-2.5 in Fig S5F, 1.4 in Fig 6G, 4.7-fold as transcript in Fig 6D. And the ChIP-Seq is cited as Fig S5G when S5G is the colony assay and the tracks are in S5E.

Osteocalcin in Fig S1C rises in the paired marrow but is flat in the tumour itself, marked ns against control, in a panel where Runx2, Osterix and Col1a1 all rise in both. The osteoblastic identity the model rests on is not uniform across its markers.

Every contradicts pointer in this manifest now carries a needle that is a fragment of the target locator's snippet, so an index that slips no longer passes silently. Verified mechanically: four pointers, each resolving to an existing text-surface entry that is not itself, each needle contained in the snippet it names.

The headline finding of the first pass is unchanged and independent of the supplement: the published title asserts the opposite of the body, the abstract and the Figure 6 caption. WWOX loss raises MYC in bone as it does in liver.

evidence_basis: Schema-v2 work manifest with 16 verified locators, four contradiction pairs each carrying contradicts plus a needle drawn from the target's snippet; strict PASS with zero gaps.

THREE OF SIX FIGURE CAPTION TITLES ASSERT THE OPPOSITE OF THEIR OWN PANELS. Fig 2: 'Combined loss of Wwox and Brca1 redirects the DSB repair to NHEJ in vivo' — the panel shows 53BP1 (NHEJ) falling from ~0.123 to ~0.027 (***) and RAD51 (HDR) rising from ~0.008 to ~0.052 (***) on WWOX loss, i.e. redirection AWAY from NHEJ. Fig 4: 'Loss of WWOX significantly reduces HDR repair' — the experiment is overexpression, panels labelled EV against WWOX OE, and the caption's own body says so eleven words later. Fig 5: 'Loss of WWOX doesn't lead to more DNA damage but does increase NHEJ' — again overexpression, and 'loss increases NHEJ' inverts the paper's own model.

The body, the Results section headings and the graphical abstract (Fig 6) are all CORRECT and mutually consistent: WWOX presence directs repair to NHEJ, WWOX loss compromises NHEJ and raises HDR. Only the caption titles invert. This is the same shape as PMID 38182577 read the same day, where the published article title inverts its own body — second consecutive paper from the same laboratory in which the headline surface, not the science, is wrong.

A FOURTH CONTRADICTION, against the running text rather than a caption: 'we did not detect any notable variations in the levels of damage among the distinct cell lines or genotypes (Fig. 5A-D)' is contradicted by Fig 5C, which prints ** twice for MDA-MB-231 (gammaH2AX EV ~3.2 against OE ~5.8 with cisplatin; ~3.6 against ~5.5 with ATMi plus cisplatin). The inference that the RAD51 and 53BP1 differences cannot be a damage effect does not hold in the cell line where those differences are largest.

Two limits the text does not state. The SeeSaw reporter does not see-saw: HDR gates sit at 0.03-0.83 percent of events in both lines, so the reported absence of an HDR difference rests on a measurement at the floor, and only NHEJ moves (231: 6.0 to 10.7 percent, **). And the in vivo control arm that carries the whole contrast — the genotype developing no tumours — shows two censoring marks in Fig 1B with no group size printed anywhere in the panel, while all three pairwise comparisons are marked ***.

Every target snippet in this manifest is extended to include the author's own figure citation, following the rule A established today: which panel a sentence concerns is then the source's assertion rather than the reader's. All four pairs satisfy it; none required inventing a link.

The three caption locators are declared surface body, not figure, because the caption text is authored prose carried in the JATS body container and is verified character-for-character against the artifact. Labelling a caption quote 'figure' would exempt it from that verification — the silent exemption found on PMID30290271 entries[8]. The validator refused the first draft of this manifest on exactly that ground and was right to.

evidence_basis: Schema-v2 work manifest with 29 verified locators, three contradiction pairs each carrying contradicts, a needle drawn from the target's snippet and a cited_panel_check; all three pass the cited-panel invariant. Strict PASS, zero gaps.

WHY THIS PAPER WAS QUEUED, AND WHY THE REASON WAS WRONG. It was queued as the in vitro source PMID 38499540 says its in vivo direction corresponds with. Reading it falsifies that: 38499540 cites this paper at [35] and [36] for the ATM axis, and in its Discussion names it as a CONFLICT — 'In contrast, a previous paper by Abu-Odeh and colleagues, has shown that WWOX enhances HDR in U2OS cells [36]'. The 'correspond with previous in vitro findings' sentence cites [17], [38] and [39], none of which is this paper. My earlier multihop mapping put this PMID at refs 17 and 34; both were wrong, and the 38499540 manifest is corrected in the same commit. Same failure shape as the panel audit run hours earlier, one level up: a citation attributed to a sentence without reading the number the sentence carries.

THE CONFLICT IS REAL, AUTHOR-ACKNOWLEDGED, AND SHARPER THAN THE PUBLISHED EXPLANATION. This paper: WWOX overexpression roughly doubles homologous recombination in a U2OS DR-GFP reporter, 10.0 to 20.8 percent, P<0.01. PMID 38499540: loss of WWOX gives more RAD51 foci and fewer 53BP1 foci in vivo, i.e. more HDR. Both carry Aqeilan as senior author. 38499540 attributes the discrepancy to different cell lines and reporter systems. The panel adds what that explanation omits: Fig 3E contains NO loss-of-function arm at all — every bar is a construct added to U2OS — so one paper measures gain and the other loss, and the two results are not symmetric opposites of one another.

THE FINDING WITH THE LONGEST REACH: WWOX carries K63-linked polyubiquitination at K274, mediated by ITCH, and the chain STABILISES the protein — the K274R mutant has a shorter half-life and fails to accumulate in the nucleus. This is the direct inverse of the textbook default recorded in the dismissal ledger's DEFAULTS THAT BIT US table, polyubiquitination read as a proteasomal death sentence. It is a mechanistic DATO about WWOX itself, so the re-audit rule applies: rejections resting on 'ubiquitinated therefore degraded' need re-scanning against it.

FOUR CONTRADICTIONS, THREE OF THEM ONE SHAPE. 'no altered expressions of FHIT and MAF (Fig. 1A)' — MAF reads ~1.45 at 1 h and ~0.62 at 2 h, larger departures than WWOX itself shows at 1 h, in a panel with no significance mark anywhere. 'Nuclear GST-WWOX, but not WWOX-WFPA, was found to be polyubiquitinated (Fig. 5B)' — the WFPA lanes carry a clear ladder, weaker than wild type, not absent. 'ectopic expression of ITCH but not a catalytic mutant mediated WWOX ubiquitination (Fig. 7A, lane 3 vs. lane 5)' — lane 5 carries a visible ladder. All three convert a quantitative reduction into an absolute negative, which is the same construction as 'did not affect control BM cells' in PMID 38182577 from the same laboratory.

THE FOURTH IS TEXT AGAINST CAPTION AND HAS NO GRAMMAR. The Results say the 15-minute foci comparison follows 'NCS treatment (Fig. 3C)'; the caption of Fig 3C says 'ionizing radiation (5 Gy)', and the sentence setting up the experiment says ionizing radiation too. Both members are text surfaces, and contradicts is defined only on a figure entry, so the pair is carried in the propositions with no pointer. Reported to the orchestrator as a gap in the schema, alongside A's finding that contradicts cannot cross manifests.

LIMITS VISIBLE ONLY IN THE PANELS. Fig 2C: p-KAP1 in the knockdown is absent at 5 min and comparable to control by 30 min, so the defect is kinetic, not a reduction in amplitude — and the paper's own feed-forward model predicts exactly that; total H2AX, the substrate, is loaded unevenly between the two pools while GAPDH is even. Fig 3A: the knockout is not 'delayed' but flat — 1±1 foci at 0, 5 and 15 min — and WT and KO are single clones, CL-8 and CL-9. Fig 3C: the difference the text calls 'higher numbers' is 256 against 9, plotted across a broken axis. Fig 3D: no significance test of any kind on the microhomology claim. Fig 6A: the K274R input is far fainter than wild type, so the ubiquitination comparison is unnormalised against a bait the paper itself reports as less stable.

FIGURE SURFACE. The publisher CDN serves 760 px copies; the rasters deposited in the article PDF are 1397 px for Figures 2, 3, 4 and 6. All seven were extracted from the PDF by xref with no resampling and fingerprinted, and the extraction recipe — source PDF digest, page, xref, pixel dimensions, image SHA-256 — is in the manifest under figure_extractions so a reader with their own copy regenerates the identical bytes. The PDF is an image container here only: its text layer is not a declared text surface and no locator is matched against it.

FIG 7D IS A SCHEMATIC AND IS DECLARED AS ONE. The model panel is a drawing downstream of the authors' prose, not an observation; its caption calls it 'Hypothetical'. It is recorded through its caption text, verified character-for-character, and deliberately NOT declared as a figure locator, because a figure surface in this schema means something read from pixels. This is an early instance of the schematic-surface problem the orchestrator is drafting a rule for.

evidence_basis: TARGETED PARTIAL UPDATE. Exactly one previously unread supplement item, Figure S8, was inspected. Paper-level figures and supplementary remain conservatively not_read because the remaining figure/supplement set was not completed; this event does not clear the paper's full-reading debt.

The original supplement was recovered: mmc1.pdf is 2,414,872 bytes, 10 PDF pages, SHA-256 dd4919a80af937037309eddd2939db4f11af230e00849bf4b362832bcb5572e9. mmc2.pdf is 25,838,791 bytes, 27 parser-enumerated pages, SHA-256 523b09e47b52620cacda9826bce88ac77dd8de65626f5148e2c8630383869cb4, and duplicates S8 on page 27.

The ordinary PMC URL first returned HTTP 200 text/html, 1,817 bytes, titled Preparing to download. Its source declares POW_CHALLENGE, POW_DIFFICULTY=4 and POW_COOKIE_NAME=cloudpmc-viewer-pow. A SHA-256 nonce satisfying the declared four-zero prefix was computed and the same public URL retried with the declared cookie, returning HTTP 200 application/pdf. A second live fetch through the new reusable script was byte-identical to the retained mmc1.pdf.

Effective PPI was measured before rendering. On S8 the 32 raster placements have min/median/max 91.0/199.1/270.5 PPI. A/B survival plots are vector. C/D are 263.2-270.5 PPI; microscopy and panel I approximately 199 PPI; the panel F blot only 91.0-94.7 PPI. The full page was inspected at 271 dpi and vector-only text/brackets at 600 dpi.

S8 contains no P0 treatment. Panel A to P40 includes WT+RI n=6, KO+RI n=6, P1 n=6, P2 n=6, P3 n=3 and P5 n=7; P4 is absent. Panel B to P300 contains only controls plus P1 and P5; P2, P3 and P4 are absent. Thus S8 does not itself map a complete P0-P5 survival window.

Panels C and D contain WT, KO and P1-P5 at P14. The only drawn brackets are WT-vs-KO, significant, and WT-vs-P5, ns. No treated-vs-KO comparison, no P1-P4 comparison with either control and no comparison among treatment days is drawn. Ns is a failure to detect a difference, not an equivalence test.

Panels E-I test P5 only. MBP in panel G is representative and unquantified. GFAP panel I draws WT-vs-KO significant and WT-vs-P5 ns, not KO-vs-P5. These panels support a P5 biological effect but cannot compare efficacy across P1-P5.

Corrected inference: efficacy is demonstrated at several early postnatal dosing times including P5, but S8 does not establish equal or full rescue at every day, long-term survival for P2-P4, a P0 result, or the upper therapeutic boundary. Beyond P5 remains untested.

🔴 THE CENTRAL PHENOTYPE IS ALMOST ENTIRELY IN THE ENGINEERED KNOCKOUT. Figure 2F plots cell-fraction log2FC against WT: the WWOX-KO loses neurons at about -2.6 with radial glia up about +0.55, while SCAR12 and WOREE both sit within roughly 0.2 of WT on both populations, and panel E shows both patient lines carrying a neuronal fraction comparable to wild type. The paper is titled 'impairs neurogenesis in human brain organoids'. On composition, the two patient-derived genotypes are close to wild type; the impairment is the CRISPR knockout's. FOUND — it is the first thing panel F shows on opening it.

The patient lines are not phenotype-free: Figure 5F and 5G show both inverting the early/late neuronal balance, roughly 65/35 against wild type's 35/65. Composition and maturation are separable, and what the patient cells carry is the second. FOUND, reading the panels.

🔴 THE FUNCTIONAL PILLAR IS NOT MYC-SELECTIVE. The MYC-inhibition experiment uses A51, which the paper itself calls a multi-kinase inhibitor established to suppress Wnt and MYC, at 125 nM from week 8 to 15. Any causal attribution to MYC inherits that ambiguity. It is also the first pharmacological intervention in a human WWOX-deficient neural model in this corpus, and belongs in the hypothesis ledger at IPOTESI level with a BLOCK-1 question attached. FOUND while reading the supplementary Methods for the dose.

🔴 THE THREE EXPERIMENTS CARRYING THE THESIS ARE THE THREE WITHOUT INDEPENDENT DIFFERENTIATIONS. The statistics section names single-cell RNA-seq, MYC inhibition and NSCs ChIP-seq as the exceptions; everything else was replicated across independent differentiations. FOUND, reading the statistics to interpret the panels.

No randomization or blinding was applied, stated without qualification. Against the same laboratory's other two papers read the same day this is a gradient: unconditional in PMID 34747138, 'when feasible' in PMID 42422765, none here. FOUND — recognised because the other two were in mind, not because a gradient was being looked for. What this paper does better than both: normality tested, ANOVA with Tukey or Dunnett, and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR named.

🔴 ASYMMETRIC SIGNIFICANCE IN THE ChIP-seq PANEL. Figure 4J tests MYC promoter binding at immature-neuron genes against 1000 random gene sets; the caption gives a P value for the wild type only, and the panel puts WT outside the null distribution and the KO inside it. 'Not significant for the KO' is what the panel supports and not what the paper states — the CLAIM 005 structure again. FOUND, from the caption giving one P where the panel shows two conditions.

🔴 THE SAFETY READING IS HALF ITS FIGURE'S TITLE. The article cites Supplementary Fig. 10C-F for the absence of radial-glia effects and calls it a safety profile; that figure is titled 'Neuron-targeted gene therapy affects cortical layer marker expression, with no effect on radial glia transcriptome'. The radial-glia half is quoted, the cortical-layer half is not. FOUND while mapping the supplementary volume.

Figure 5E lists canonical Wnt signalling among negatively-enriched processes and A51 suppresses Wnt, so I was about to record that the rescue inhibits a pathway already down in the mutants. The caption states the contrast is late cells versus early cells — developmental stage, not genotype — so nothing about WWOX follows. The rule adopted earlier today, that a figure is not read until its caption is read, held on its first test; the only difference from the morning's three failures is that I looked before asserting.

THE FINDING, AND IT WAS QUALIFIED BY THE EVIDENCE AGAINST MY OWN FIRST VERSION. Figure 2F shows the engineered knockout losing neurons at about -2.6 log2FC while SCAR12 and WOREE sit within about 0.2 of wild type; Supplementary 8F shows the direct WOREE-versus-SCAR12 volcano essentially empty; Supplementary 5B shows mitotic progenitors at **** for the knockout, * for WOREE and no bracket for SCAR12. I recorded three times that the phenotype is almost entirely the knockout's. Supplementary Figure 4 corrects that: in RADIAL GLIA all three lines carry MYC activation at comparable magnitude, pseudobulk logFC on wild type of about 1.8, 1.65 and 1.6. The molecular lesion in the progenitor compartment is shared; what the knockout carries disproportionately is the downstream consequence. Separating the lesion from its penetrance is a better result than assigning both to one line.

🔴 THE RESCUE DOES NOT SET A LEVEL. WWOX protein after AAV9, relative to wild type, ranges from 0.4 to 7 across lines treated with the same vector — SCAR12 WPM S1 reaches 7, WOREE lines 0.4 to 0.9, engineered knockouts 0.8 and 1.4. A seventeen-fold spread. Alongside SATB2 at about ten-fold above wild type and TCF-4 at 0.3, the pattern across this paper is not overshoot in one direction but absence of level control. With PMID 34747138's doubled unmyelinated axons and PMID 42422765's behavioural measures above wild type, three papers now show a rescue that is real on survival and function while leaving molecular readouts off wild type in both directions.

🔴 PATIENT GENOTYPES, TABULATED ONLY IN THE SUPPLEMENT. WOREE: WSM S c.517-2A>G homozygous; LM-iPS c.864G>A over a 16q23.1 deletion of about 93 kb; WCH S compound heterozygous c.410G>T p.Gly137Val with c.517-2A>G. SCAR12: WPM S and WPM D both c.1114G>C homozygous. c.517-2A>G is a canonical splice-acceptor variant in two independent WOREE lines, which makes characterised AAV-transducible human neural material available for the allele class the ASO track in this repository is built around.

🔴 THE FUNCTIONAL PILLAR IS NOT MYC-SELECTIVE, AND ITS RESCUE IS SELECTIVE. A51 is described by the paper as a multi-kinase inhibitor suppressing Wnt and MYC. Supplementary 7F-G: SOX2+ from about 60 to 33 percent and SOX2+MYC+ from 72 to 50, both ns against wild type; NEUN+ from 6 to 18 with *; but SATB2+ ns between knockout and A51, and CTIP2+ ns between knockout and A51 while remaining **** below wild type. Progenitor identity and pan-neuronal marking restored, layer neuron production untouched. Recorded as DL-THER-081 at IPOTESI with the BLOCK-1 question written out: suppressing Wnt during corticogenesis is the mechanism, not a side effect, and the window between reducing excess progenitors and preventing normal development is measured nowhere here.

Three constraints the paper declares about itself: single-cell RNA-seq, MYC inhibition and NSCs ChIP-seq are the three experiments excluded from independent differentiations, and they are the three the WWOX-MYC thesis rests on; no randomization or blinding was applied; and against that, this is the only one of the laboratory's three papers read today that names its multiplicity correction.

Two panel-versus-text findings: Figure 4J gives a P value for wild type only while placing the knockout inside the null distribution, so 'not significant for the KO' is what the panel supports and not what the paper states; and the safety sentence cites a figure titled 'affects cortical layer marker expression, with no effect on radial glia transcriptome', quoting the second half and not the first.

A false inference prevented: Figure 5E lists canonical Wnt among negatively-enriched processes and A51 suppresses Wnt, but the caption states the contrast is late versus early cells, so nothing about WWOX follows. Reading the caption before asserting is the only difference from three failures earlier the same day.

🔴 A FIGURE GENERATED BY A LANGUAGE MODEL CONTRADICTS THE RUNNING TEXT, AND OUR FIGURE RULE POINTS THE WRONG WAY. Section 1 lists six categories of CFS-mapped neurodevelopmental gene including glutamate receptor signaling (GRID1, GRM5). Figure 2 shows five: the category is gone, GRID1 appears nowhere, and GRM5 has been moved under neuron projection development. The caption enumerates the same five, so caption and panel agree and both differ from the body. The caption's last sentence is 'This figure was prepared using Gemini.' Rule 5c privileges the panel because on 2026-08-04 a panel reversed a conclusion the text did not carry — a rule written for DATA panels, where the panel is the observation. This panel is a rendering downstream of the prose. A reader applying the 5c default would carry away that GRM5 is a neuron-projection gene and GRID1 is not a CFS-linked gene at all; both are wrong and the text was right. PREMISE_TAG: the load-bearing premise of 5c is that a figure is an observation. PREMISE: DEFAULT_FROM_TEXTBOOK, false for this class. The discriminator is already in the document — all four captions declare their generator.

🔴 THE REVIEW SAYS 'RESTORED' WHERE ITS OWN PRIMARY SHOWS TEN-FOLD ABOVE WILD TYPE. Section 10.4 describes Steinberg et al. 2024 — PMID 42397075, closed as a complete read earlier the same day — as having 'restored deep-layer neuronal markers (CTIP2, SATB2)'. That paper's Supplementary Figure 10B-C, recorded in PMID42397075.json entries[22], reads SATB2 mRNA in treated WOREE organoids at about ten times wild type and BCL11B/CTIP2 at about three. The word survives because the WT-versus-treated bracket is not drawn, which I had recorded in that same entry. Same laboratory, same first author on the review as on the optimisation primary.

🔴 THE WPRE LOOP CLOSES INSIDE ONE DOCUMENT AND NEITHER END MENTIONS THE OTHER. Section 10.4 frames WPRE removal as 'aimed at avoiding excessive or poorly controlled transgene expression while preserving sufficient therapeutic efficacy'. PMID 42422765 entries[15] shows removal required a six-fold dose increase to recover efficacy. Section 11 of this same review names high-dose AAV administration as the driver of DRG pathology and a key regulatory concern in paediatric CNS gene therapy. Efficacy was not preserved at dose — it was repurchased with vector, in the currency the review itself names as the safety problem.

🔴 WWOX PROTEIN ABUNDANCE IS NOT A READOUT OF WWOX FUNCTION, BRACKETED FROM BOTH SIDES. P47T knock-in mice hold WWOX protein comparable to wild type while the mutation disrupts the WW1 PPXY motif, giving partial loss of function through failed interaction rather than lost protein, in an animal with adult-onset seizures, cerebellar neurodegeneration and ataxia. SCAR12-derived forebrain organoids show the converse: minimal WWOX expression with near-normal morphology, layer markers and E/I ratio. A Tier 1/2 biomarker built on abundance would score the first normal and the second severe, and be wrong twice.

🔴 THE THREE-CLASS GENOTYPE-PHENOTYPE FRAMEWORK IS PUBLISHED AND FALSIFIED IN THE SAME SECTION. Classes: biallelic null severe and early-lethal; compound het intermediate; biallelic hypomorphic missense milder. The review's own counterexamples: an intron-4 deletion causing exon-5 skipping, category 2 by genotype and category 1 by severity (Oliver 2023); six missense patients spanning the whole range with MRI abnormalities in only two (Havali 2021); and a homozygous p.Ser304Tyr MISSENSE with rapid deterioration and death in early infancy (Feng 2024). 'Missense implies residual function implies milder' is the premise under much of the hypomorph and ASO reasoning in this repository, and it has a published counterexample that kills in infancy.

A CONDITIONAL REQUIREMENT THAT A BASELINE ASSAY REPORTS AS ABSENT. Table 1 gives Olig2-Cre; O-KO 'No major defects' at baseline and, under cuprizone, defective oligodendrocyte differentiation and impaired remyelination — called cell-autonomous, both rows citing Abudiab et al. 2025. An unchallenged oligodendroglial readout is a designed false negative for this axis. The neuronal arm is non-cell-autonomous and stated as such, so WWOX acts on myelination through both routes and each is invisible in the assay that isolates the other.

SMALLER FINDINGS CARRIED OUT: elevated potassium currents in Wwox-KO pyramidal neurons read as maladaptive compensation, a signed proximal druggable node nothing here has looked at; progressive cerebral atrophy on repeated scans, so a degenerative component inside a neurodevelopmental disorder and a cross-sectional imaging endpoint cannot see it; Kaplan-Meier stratified by allele class, so survival analyses must stratify or measure genotype mix; a homozygous splice-site allele arising from maternal uniparental disomy; lactate rises with the lesion and does not fall with the rescue, which lowers methionine instead, separating a lesion marker from a response marker; sleep variants with a circadian-independent Drosophila phenotype, making architecture rather than phase the thing to measure; and the substantia nigra reported as having little to no WWOX in section 3 while section 5 attributes PD dopaminergic loss to a WWOX-JNK axis, stated in the same document and reconciled nowhere.

🔴 A GAP IN MY OWN COMPLIANCE, DECLARED RATHER THAN BACK-DATED. The partial read of section 11 earlier today produced a dossier and a commit and NO RECEIPT — rule 7 requires one from every route that analyses a full text. Rather than write a contemporaneous-looking record after the fact, this single receipt covers the complete read and names the omission. The prior_receipt is therefore the 2026-07-26 legacy reconstruction, not the morning's work, because the morning's work has no receipt to point at.

🔴 I FIRST DECLARED THIS READING COMPLETE WITH figures: captions_only AND THE LEDGER REFUSED IT — 'a caption is authored prose, the figure is the data'. The refusal was right, and what I had skipped was the thing that mattered: Figure 1 panels F and G are the Sanger traces, and this paper contradicts itself about the variant. So I inspected them. The trio is fully resolved in the panel and only asserted in the text: the proband is homozygous on FORWARD and on REVERSE reads, both parents are heterozygous carriers for WWOX, and the mother is WILD-TYPE for CACNA1A, which is what makes that allele exclusively paternal. That is the strongest evidence in the paper and none of it is in the running text.

🔴 AND THE ADJUDICATION I OPENED THE PANEL FOR FAILED, WHICH IS ITSELF A RESULT. I went to the traces to settle c.911 against c.991. The panel shows the substitution is C→A — the proband's boxed base reads A where both parents read C, against identical flanking sequence — which is consistent with BOTH candidates, because both are C>A. A chromatogram carries no coordinate. The figure corroborates the substitution and is silent on the position, so the only thing that settles it remains arithmetic: codon 304 spans nucleotides 910-912. Recording a failed adjudication as failed is cheaper than leaving a reader to assume the figure settled it. I also declined to adjudicate the EEG: one representative epoch cannot establish the regional distribution its caption claims, and reading one from a reproduction is the cross-figure over-reach that already failed three times today.

🔴 THE FIGURE ROUTE IS ITSELF A FINDING, AND IT EXERCISES THE RULE CORRECTED TONIGHT. PMC's bin path 404s for both the figure and the supplementary; the OA package is offered only over ftp://; the Frontiers HTML serves image_m at 1056x604. The publisher PDF holds the same figure at 1955x1118 with smask = 0 — 1.85x more pixels per dimension, and no soft mask, so extraction returns what the page shows. Measured before extracting. Reading a Sanger base call from the served copy would have meant reading it with a third of the pixels the publisher shipped.

🔴 THE PREMISE I WAS SENT TO TEST DOES NOT HOLD THE WAY THE REVIEW STATES IT. PMID 42128308 section 9 offers this case as one of three counterexamples that falsify the three-class genotype-phenotype framework: 'a homozygous missense WWOX mutation (p.Ser304Tyr), in which the patient exhibited rapid clinical deterioration and died in early infancy, despite the mutation type typically being associated with milder phenotypes'. The zygosity is accurate. Four things the review does not carry: the variant is ACMG 'Unclear clinical significance', stated twice, in the opening sentence of the genetic analysis and in Table 1; the authors' own final sentence says the pathogenicity 'require[s] validation through animal experiments and additional cases'; the child also carries CACNA1A c.4646A>G p.Gln1549Arg, paternal, heterozygous, against an AUTOSOMAL DOMINANT DEE-42, also a VUS; and the paper cannot agree with itself on the nucleotide.

🔴 THE PAPER CONTRADICTS ITSELF THREE TIMES ON THE VARIANT AND ARITHMETIC SETTLES IT. Running text and conclusion write c.991C>A; Table 1 and the discussion write c.911C>A. Codon 304 spans nucleotides 910-912, so c.911 falls in codon 304 and c.991 falls in codon 331 — only c.911C>A is consistent with p.Ser304Tyr. The same sentence also states the change is 'from glycine to serine' while printing p.Ser304Tyr, serine to tyrosine, in its own parenthesis. Two errors in one sentence, and the half that propagates downstream is the protein notation, which is the half that is right.

WHAT SURVIVES, AND IT IS NOT NOTHING. A child homozygous for a WWOX missense allele, from consanguineous first-cousin parents both heterozygous carriers, with onset at one month, no object tracking, no head control, bilateral hearing loss, thin corpus callosum, deepened frontal sulci and small gyri, epileptiform EEG with interhemispheric asynchrony, poor control on phenobarbital and slight improvement on levetiracetam, dead at six months. As a PHENOTYPIC observation that stands whatever the variant's formal classification. What the paper cannot establish is that the missense caused it, and that is the step the review takes.

THE VERDICT ON THE PREMISE, STATED PRECISELY. 'Missense implies residual function implies milder' is NOT falsified by this paper, because a VUS in a case report with a competing candidate variant in a dominant epilepsy gene cannot falsify a rule. It is a genuine warning and not a refutation. The two counterexamples that would settle it — Oliver 2023's intron-4 deletion and Havali 2021's six missense patients — remain unread, and they are now the highest-value queue items for this question rather than this paper.

🔴 THIRD INSTANCE IN ONE REVIEW OF THE SAME COMPRESSION, NOW ON THE CLINICAL SIDE. PMID 42128308 states 'restored' where its own primary shows ten-fold overshoot; frames WPRE removal as a safety choice where the primary shows a six-fold dose cost; and here compresses a VUS with a competing candidate variant into 'despite the mutation type typically being associated with milder phenotypes'. Three times the review states the simple half. That is a property of the review worth carrying, and it was only visible by reading what it cites.

A GARBLED ATTRIBUTION IN THE THERAPEUTIC PARAGRAPH, WHICH IS THE PARAGRAPH A CLINICIAN WOULD ACT ON: the preclinical WWOX gene therapy is described as using 'an adenoviral vector' — it is adeno-ASSOCIATED, AAV9, a different vector class with different immunogenicity, tropism and regulatory profile — attributed to 'the Mahertz and Akhilan laboratories', corruptions of Mahzi and Aqeilan. The underlying claim is correct and is PMID 34747138, read the same day.

🔴 THE ANSWER IS BIGGER THAN THE QUESTION: THE FRAMEWORK'S MIDDLE CLASS DOES NOT EXIST IN THE DATA OF THE SOURCE THAT BUILT IT. The three-class scheme is Oliver's own construction — 'classified into three genotypic classes based on variant types: (1) null/null, (2) null/missense, (3) missense/missense'. And Oliver's own conclusion: 'We found no difference between individuals with one or two missense variants and therefore no evidence to support an intermediate phenotype'. The review PMID 42128308 presents class 2 as 'associated with intermediate phenotypes' and then offers counterexamples to a framework whose own source rejects that class. This is not a counterexample within the framework; it is the framework's source denying one of its three parts.

WHAT THE DATA DO SUPPORT IS BINARY, NOT TERNARY, AND ON ONE AXIS ONLY. 75 cases stratified null/null n=45, null/missense n=15, missense/missense n=15. Time to death: 'survival was much poorer for the double null group compared with the patients who had at least one missense pathogenic variant', p = .0085 log-rank; survival to age 5 under 50% for double null against over 75% for the other two; by age 10, 25% against over 60%. Time to seizure onset: 'we found no difference in time to seizure onset between the three genetic groups', p = .65. The paper itself groups the two missense classes as 'the other two, presumably less severe, genetic groups' — a binary split, written as such.

🔴 THE INTRON-4 CASE, WHICH IS WHAT I WAS SENT FOR, AND THE REVIEW MISREPORTS ITS CLASS. Patient 6 is tabulated as 'c.49G > A, p.Glu17Lys (mat)/intron 4 deletion (pat)' with genetic combination MISSENSE/NULL — Oliver classifies the intron-4 deletion as a null, because 'the intron 3 deletion was a benign variant, whereas the intron 4 variant resulted in exon 5 skipping'. So it is an ordinary class-2 case by Oliver's own coding, not an anomaly. The review calls it a case that 'technically falls under category 2 ... with one allele lacking a canonical deletion mutation' whose severity matched category 1 — but in a scheme where class 2 shows no intermediate phenotype, a class-2 patient being as severe as class 1 is the expected result, not a counterexample.

🔴 AND MISSENSE IS NOT A SEVERITY CLASS AT ALL, WHICH IS THE DEEPER ANSWER TO THE HYPOMORPH PREMISE. 'p.Pro47 has been associated with two pathogenic variants; the more conservative change to threonine was found in SCAR12' compared with the arginine substitution found in WWOX-DEE. The SAME RESIDUE, two substitutions, two diseases — mild SCAR12 and severe DEE. And 'no region of the gene emerged as specific' for DEE versus SCAR12: the two SCAR12 missense variants sit in close proximity to DEE variants. So severity is substitution-specific, not residue-specific and not region-specific, and 'missense implies residual function implies milder' fails at the level of its own category. This closes a loop with PMID 42128308: P47T is the SCAR12 mouse allele that holds WWOX protein at wild-type level while disrupting the WW1 PPXY motif.

A DATUM THAT LANDS ON THIS REPOSITORY'S OWN PROTEOSTASIS TRACK. p.Gln230Pro occurs in three of Oliver's twelve unrelated patients — homozygous in two, compound heterozygous in one — and in six previously reported families from Iran, Afghanistan, France and Morocco. Q230P is therefore the most recurrent WWOX-DEE missense allele in the literature, and the allele the proteostasis work here is built around. Also p.Glu17Lys in two of their patients and one reported case.

ASCERTAINMENT, DECLARED BY THE PAPER: their 13 are notably older than the 62 published cases (mean 8y2m against 3y4m) and their mortality is lower (23% against 38%), with null/null at 50% against 60% and null/missense at 33% against 15.5%. A cohort that is older, less null-heavy and less lethal than the literature it is pooled with — which is a reason to read the survival curve as a comparison between groups and not as an absolute prognosis.

So the quotes live here, each verified unique against the extracted body, and SEVEN OF THE NINE also appear verbatim in the raw markup — chosen deliberately to avoid crossing an italic boundary, so they are verbatim in both senses rather than only against the extractor's artefact. 🔴 THE RESULT THIS PAPER WAS CHOSEN FOR: ZERO contradictions. It was read as a control on my own contradiction rate, which was 29.3% against 12-18% for the other readers, on a sample that was three-quarters one laboratory. Here the text agrees with its own tables everywhere I checked: 'more than two-fold stronger' for the WW2W mutant is 144/54 = 2.7x, and for the tandem module 383/170, 362/175, 144/68 are 2.25x, 2.07x and 2.12x — all three above two. On the previous four papers this class of check failed three times. ONE overstatement was found and it is in the ABSTRACT, not the body: 'exquisitely restores its binding to PPXY motifs in a manner akin to the binding of WW1 domain', where Table 3 shows the engineered domain is 2.7-fold BETTER on PY3 and roughly 1.8-fold WORSE on PY1 and PY2. The body says 'rather weakly' and is accurate. Same shape as the inverted title of 38182577 and the inverted captions of 38499540 — the travelling surface overstates while the body does not — in a paper that is otherwise scrupulous.

ANSWER TO THE ORCHESTRATOR'S QUESTION — did I find the four 'reduction written as absence' instances, or go looking for them? One line each, honestly. (1) 'did not affect control BM cells', PMID 38182577: FOUND, while inspecting Fig 7C for the simvastatin dose-response; I was not looking for a rhetorical pattern and none had been named yet. (2) 'no altered expressions of FHIT and MAF', PMID 25331887: FOUND, reading Fig 1A as the first panel of that paper, before any pattern was in mind that session. (3) 'Nuclear GST-WWOX, but not WWOX-WFPA', PMID 25331887: SOUGHT — by then I had seen instance 2 in the same paper and was reading absolute negatives with suspicion. (4) 'ITCH but not a catalytic mutant', PMID 25331887: SOUGHT, same session, same suspicion, and the text even named the lanes to check. So two of four were found and two were sought. The pattern is real — the panels say what they say — but its FREQUENCY is inflated by the order in which I read, and a rate computed over instances 3 and 4 is not independent of instances 1 and 2.

THE FINDING WITH THE WIDEST REACH IS ABOUT A REAGENT, NOT A PHENOTYPE. W44 is a signature tryptophan whose indole sidechain stacks the first proline of the PPXY motif; every other contact residue is conserved in WW2, which carries Y85 in its place, and the Y85W substitution restores binding. PMID 25331887 and PMID 38499540 both use the WWOX-WFPA mutant (W44F plus P47A) as the control that makes their ATM and DDR results WW1-dependent, and neither explains why it works. It works because that residue is the stacking platform. A control reagent used across this corpus gets its mechanism from a different laboratory that never mentions ATM.

AFFINITIES ARE WEAK AND SHOULD TRAVEL WITH THE CLAIM: WW1 alone binds ErbB4 PY3 at 144 +/- 16 uM, PY1 at 383 +/- 30, PY2 at 362 +/- 45; the tandem module reaches 68 +/- 8 uM at best. The authors themselves call the physiological relevance of PY1 and PY2 questionable. Any downstream statement that 'WWOX binds ErbB4' is really a statement about PY3, at tens of micromolar.

THE OPPOSITE RHETORICAL HOUSE, and it is the qualitative half of the experiment. This paper states limits the text could have hidden: its peptides may depart from physiological behaviour, two of its three sites are of questionable relevance, its light-scattering concentration was a practical necessity and the dimerisation it sees probably irrelevant, and its simulations 'cannot ascertain' the association they were run to test. On the previous four papers this class of caveat had to be recovered from panels.

FIGURES 1-7 WAIVED BY NAME, and the cost stated rather than minimised: Figures 2 and 4 are the ITC isotherms behind every Kd quoted, so the fits are unexamined; Figure 3 is the structural model behind the W44/Y85 argument, which is the finding with the widest reach; Figures 5-7 carry the light scattering and the molecular dynamics. The waiver is this session's context limit, not a property of the paper. FT-055 carries the debt. Because no panel was inspected, panel-versus-text relation could not be tested at all in this reading — the zero contradictions above are a text-and-table result, and must not be read as agreement between panels and text.

🔴 THE AUTHOR CORRECTION, READ WITH THE PAPER AND NOT AFTER IT. PMID 30470736, Published Erratum, PMC6251905: 'Since the publication of their article, the authors reported that duplication had mistakenly occurred in Fig 3A and D - H&E panels.' IMAGE DUPLICATION in two histology panels of Figure 3. Under CLAUDE.md rule 8 this is an ordinary erratum rather than a retraction or expression of concern, so it is annotated and does not raise PUBLICATION_INTEGRITY_HOLD — but image duplication is not a typographical correction and the distinction should not flatten it.

WHAT THE CORRECTION DOES AND DOES NOT TOUCH IN THIS READING, checked rather than assumed: this manifest holds one Figure 3 locator and it reads PANEL F — the qPCR bar chart of proliferative genes, where AXIN2 carries no significance mark at 1 month and c-Jun fails significance at 3 and 6 months. Panels A and D, the duplicated H&E images, carry no locator here. So no statement in this reading rests on a corrected panel. That is a fact about which panels I happened to use, not a safeguard: nothing in the pipeline checked the erratum against the locators, and had a locator sat on 3A it would have passed every gate.

THE CONSEQUENCE WORTH CARRYING FORWARD: the histology panels of this paper are the surface the authors themselves have corrected once for duplication. Any future locator on Figure 3A or 3D must be drawn from the CORRECTED version and say so, and any claim resting on the H&E morphology of this model should name which version it was read from.

SCIENTIFIC CONTENT, unchanged from the reading that produced the manifest: hepatocyte-specific Wwox deletion raises HIF1alpha occupancy on its own glycolytic target promoters (Fig 4F, five targets, all significant), and this is the third side of the hepatic triangle. Six contradictions between text and panels, all with the falsifying panel being the one the sentence cites, except the sixth whose citation is inherited from the preceding sentence and is labelled weak. Two panel-only findings that exist nowhere in the running text: florid hepatic steatosis in the knockout on NORMAL chow at 10 months (Fig 2H), and PDK1 measured at exactly one timepoint, not significant there, then dropped from the later panel (Fig 4C and 4D).

evidence_basis: 🔴 WHAT THIS DOCUMENT IS, AND IT DETERMINES WHAT THE RECEIPT CAN MEAN. article-type="article-commentary" — an Author's View: a solicited commentary by the authors on their own recent paper. No methods, no results, no statistics, no primary data of any kind. Both XML routes agree on the type. So `complete_fulltext_read` here is honest but SMALL: the body is 11,944 characters, four paragraphs, one figure, ten references, and completeness is a property of a three-page document rather than a claim about effort. Recorded at complete because there is genuinely nothing unread — table-wrap count is zero in both routes and neither oa.fcgi nor the PDF carries a supplement, checked rather than assumed. Where earlier receipts this week were refused at complete and rightly so, the refusal was about an unread supplement that existed; here the slot is empty.

THE ASSIGNMENT'S QUESTION HAS A NEGATIVE ANSWER. The task was to find which figure carries the WW1/W44-dependence assertion. It carries none: every empirical statement here is a restatement of PMID 25331887, and the paper's only figure is a schematic model. The negative answer is what made the reading valuable, because it turned the run into a comparison between a paper this corpus has read completely and its own authors' summary of it.

🔴 THE FINDING: FOUR HEDGES PRESENT IN THE PRIMARY PAPER ARE ABSENT FROM ITS OWN AUTHOR'S VIEW, and each is anchored on both sides against a fingerprinted artifact. (1) THE MODAL. The primary writes 'WWOX depletion (hemizygous mutation) or loss (homozygous mutation) MIGHT RESULT IN reduced activation of ATM and substrate phosphorylation'; the commentary's figure caption writes the same construction as 'RESULTS IN'. Identical wording, epistemic operator deleted. (2) THE WORD 'HYPOTHETICAL'. The primary captions its model 'Hypothetical model of WWOX action in DDR'; 'hypothetic' occurs ZERO times in the entire commentary, whose redrawn model is declarative throughout. (3) THE CITATION FOR ATM->ITCH. The primary writes 'After DNA damage, ATM positively regulates the ligase activity of ITCH (42)' — ref 42 being Santini et al., Oncogene 2014, a third party. The commentary asserts the same step in its figure caption with no citation, inside a model presented as the authors' own, and ref 42 is not in its reference list at all. (4) THE ATTRIBUTION FOR STABILISATION. The commentary attributes ITCH/K63/K274-mediated stabilisation to ref 5 = PMID 25331887; but 25331887 itself attributes it to ITS ref 3 = PMID 24550385, where reader A found the actual measurement this session. The citation moved one link and landed on the paper that was citing, not the paper that measured.

WHY THIS IS A METHOD FINDING AND NOT A COMPLAINT. The single surviving 'might' in the whole commentary sits on the introductory hypothesis the authors then report confirming — the one place a hedge costs nothing. And the figure's only uncertainty mark, a bold '?', sits beside the MRE11/RAD50/NBS1 spheres: a complex named nowhere in this commentary's text and nowhere in the primary's running prose either. Hedging vocabulary is not lost here, it is REDISTRIBUTED — retained on the superseded hypothesis and on what is not the authors' claim, removed from the live conclusions that are. That is the ordinary asymmetry of confidence in one's own results, which is exactly why a commentary cannot be read as a summary of what is established.

🔴 WHY IT MATTERS TO THIS DISEASE MODEL SPECIFICALLY, and it is the one thing here that is not methodological. The schematic labels its arms with GENOTYPE SYMBOLS — WWOX(+/+) against WWOX(+/-) stacked above WWOX(-/-) — and the mutant arm terminates in a drawn arrow to 'Cancer'. The experiments behind that arm are HEK293-Sh-WWOX, MCF7-shWWOX and Wwox-KO MEFs: a knockdown and a null. THERE IS NO HETEROZYGOUS SYSTEM ANYWHERE IN THE PRIMARY PAPER, which is why the primary wrote 'might'. A caption sentence can be read as shorthand for 'cells with less WWOX'; a printed WWOX(+/-) on a diagram cannot, and it is the most transferable form a claim can take. For a model whose carriers' parents are heterozygotes, that is a specific transfer risk, and it was caught by looking at pixels rather than by reading the caption.

THE CONTROL CASE, recorded first in the manifest on purpose: not everything here is inflated. WWOX-dependent ATM monomerization is a real measurement — Fig 4D of the primary, a Flag-ATM/YFP-ATM co-immunoprecipitation — and this corpus already holds a locator on that exact panel at PMID25331887 entries[26]. The commentary's strongest verb, 'revealed', is earned there. Four deltas against a document that is otherwise accurate is the only kind of delta worth reporting.

FT-053 NARROWS RATHER THAN CLOSES. Reader A's reading of PMID 24550385 supplies the ITCH arm of the stabilisation question by gain and loss of function, half of it in untransfected cells. It does not supply the K274 arm: 'half-life of WWOX-K274R is shorter compared with WWOX' still rests on Fig. S7B in the unreachable supplement of 25331887. Re-specified in the queue rather than left standing, because a debt that is never re-specified is one nobody can finish paying.

A COINED FIELD, DECLARED AS UNCHECKED. The cross-document relation between the commentary's sentence and the primary's hedged original is carried in `cross_document_relation` / `restates` / `restates_needle`, following main's pointer-and-needle grammar. It is NOT in main's schema and main's validator ignores it entirely, so the manifest passes without those three fields being checked at all — which is the silent-green shape this repository exists to prevent. PANEL_TEXT_RELATIONS was deliberately not widened: its name scopes it to how a panel stands to a text, and this relation holds between two documents. The needle rule was therefore run by hand against main's own _match_key — the fragment belongs to the target's snippet and to no other entry's — and the result is recorded in the manifest. A hand-run check is weaker than a gate and is offered as the argument for building one, in FT-058.
